_about: THE ONE LIST of settings changed from the admin panel (19 Nov 2026). Read by the engine (config/live_settings.py) and by the website (server/lib/engineSettings.ts), so both check a value the same way. 'default' must equal config/settings.py — tests/test_live_settings.py fails if it does not.

groups.title: Autotrade limits
groups.hint: What autotrade may place by itself, and when. Orders you decide in your DM (Confirm, /level, Tradeable) skip the pairs, strategies, sessions and cut-off.

groups.title: Signal quality
groups.hint: The minimum a signal must reach before it is sent at all.

groups.title: Signal delivery
groups.hint: Where signal cards go: the public channel or your DM.

groups.title: Engine switches
groups.hint: Take effect within a few seconds. The real-time price watcher is not here: it is read once at start-up, so it stays in Coolify.

groups.title: Options levels (Barchart)
groups.hint: The day's buy and sell levels from Barchart's next-day options, read 10 minutes after the Sydney, London and New York opens.

groups.title: Broker accounts
groups.hint: Limits on the journal's connected accounts. Read by the website; takes effect on the next account added.

settings.name: autotrade_symbols
settings.label: Pairs autotrade may place
settings.help: Comma-separated, e.g. eur/usd,gbp/usd. Empty means every pair. Signals on other pairs come to your DM as Confirm cards.

settings.name: autotrade_strategies
settings.label: Strategies autotrade may place
settings.help: Comma-separated strategy ids: vix1, bx_sd, pix. Empty means all. Other strategies' signals come to your DM as Confirm cards.

settings.name: autotrade_sessions
settings.label: Sessions autotrade may place in
settings.help: Comma-separated: asian, london, new_york. Empty means any time.

settings.name: autotrade_cutoff_utc
settings.label: Daily cut-off (UTC)
settings.help: HH:MM in UTC; 16:00 UTC is 7pm Kenyan time. Empty means no cut-off.

settings.name: autotrade_risk_pct
settings.label: Risk per trade (% of starting balance)
settings.help: Between 0.1 and 5.

settings.name: autotrade_max_lots
settings.label: Largest order (lots)
settings.help: No order is ever bigger than this. Between 0.01 and 50.

settings.name: autotrade_max_per_day
settings.label: Most filled trades in 24 hours
settings.help: A whole number between 1 and 50. Applies to your DM orders too.

settings.name: min_rr
settings.label: Minimum reward-to-risk
settings.help: A signal whose target is less than this many times its stop is dropped. Between 0.5 and 10.

settings.name: min_confidence
settings.label: Minimum confidence
settings.help: Between 0 and 1.

settings.name: min_confidence_overrides
settings.label: Minimum confidence per strategy
settings.help: strategy:number pairs, comma-separated, e.g. vix1:0.60.

settings.name: signals_dm_only
settings.label: Hold signals back in my DM
settings.help: Emergency switch. On: every strategy's signals go to your DM, except the strategies listed in the next box.

settings.name: dm_only_exempt
settings.label: Strategies whose entries may go to the channel
settings.help: Comma-separated strategy ids. Any strategy not listed sends its entries to your DM.

settings.name: channel_entries_only
settings.label: Channel gets entry signals only
settings.help: On: the channel carries entry signals only; heads-ups and results (target / stop hit) go to your DM.

settings.name: channel_all
settings.label: Strategies whose every card goes to the channel
settings.help: Comma-separated strategy ids.

settings.name: copy_bot_dm_strategies
settings.label: Strategies sent to my DM through the copy bot
settings.help: Comma-separated strategy ids.

settings.name: scan_enabled
settings.label: Scanning for signals
settings.help: Off: no strategy looks for setups.

settings.name: auto_breakeven_enabled
settings.label: Auto-breakeven
settings.help: On: the engine moves a running trade's stop to breakeven by itself.

settings.name: gold_banking_enabled
settings.label: Bank gold profit in pieces
settings.help: On: gold closes part at 1R and 2R (half an R each), then a piece each time the rest earns another 0.2R. Off: gold keeps only breakeven.

settings.name: barchart_enabled
settings.label: Post the options levels
settings.help: On: each open, the levels are read and posted. Off: nothing is read.

settings.name: barchart_to_dm
settings.label: Send the levels to my DM instead of the channel
settings.help: On: only you see them.

settings.name: max_accounts_per_user
settings.label: Most broker accounts one user may connect
settings.help: A whole number between 1 and 1000. Adding one more is refused with this number in the message; accounts already connected are never removed.
